title: Lead Enterprise MarTech & Programmatic Consultant
description_raw: Seeking a Lead Enterprise MarTech Consultant with 5+ years experience. Must have hands-on enterprise expertise with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), Marketo, and programmatic media buying on Display & Video 360 (DV360) and The Trade Desk. Candidate will manage enterprise monthly media budgets exceeding INR 1.5 Crores.
responsibilities: Architect enterprise customer journeys across Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Execute programmatic DSP buys via DV360 and Trade Desk.
